title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description: SAP Assistant Project Manager (SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition SaaS - Greenfield Implementation)**
  
**Position Title:** SAP Assistant Project Manager
  
**Location:** Hisar, Haryana (Onsite at Customer Location)
  
**Customer:** Government DISCOM (Power Distribution Utility)
  
**Project Type:** SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) SaaS Greenfield Implementation
  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 10 years of total work experience and 7 Years Relevant SAP Project Management and ERP Implementation Experience.
  
Should have managed at least two large System Integration projects preferably with Central/State Government or Private Organizations in the Power Sector.  
  
  
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract
  
**Role Overview**
  
We are seeking an experienced **SAP Assistant Project Manager** to lead a large-scale **SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) Greenfield Implementation** for a Government Power Distribution Company (DISCOM) in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, stakeholder management, governance, risk management, quality assurance, and successful implementation of SAP industry best practices across utility business processes.
  
The Project Manager will act as the primary liaison between the customer, implementation partner, SAP, system integrators, and other stakeholders while ensuring timely and budget-compliant project execution.
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Project Leadership & Governance**

* Lead complete lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA PCE Greenfield implementation from project initiation to go-live and hypercare.
* Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Establish project governance framework and conduct Steering Committee meetings.
* Ensure compliance with Government, DISCOM, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage project scope, change requests, and contractual obligations.

**SAP Program Management**

* Drive SAP Activate methodology and implementation best practices.
* Coordinate solution design, realization, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Manage multiple workstreams including:
  + Finance & Controlling (FI/CO)
  + Materials Management (MM)
  + Sales & Distribution (SD)
  + Asset Management (EAM/PM)
  + Project Systems (PS)
  + Human Capital Management (HCM/SuccessFactors integration)
  + SAP IS-Utility integrations
  + Analytics and Reporting

**Stakeholder Management**

* Engage with Government officials, DISCOM executives, business heads, consultants, SAP teams, and vendor partners.
* Facilitate requirement workshops and executive presentations.
* Manage communication across all project stakeholders.
* Present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to senior management.

**Utility Industry Transformation**

* Understand and align utilities business processes such as:
  + Power Distribution Operations
  + Metering and Billing
  + Procurement and Inventory
  + Asset Lifecycle Management
  + Financial Accounting
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Budget and Capital Project Management

**Risk & Quality Management**

* Identify project risks, dependencies, and issues proactively.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Ensure quality assurance across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
* Monitor project health through KPIs and dashboards.

**Team Management**

* Lead cross-functional teams comprising SAP consultants, developers, infrastructure specialists, and business users.
* Manage project resource allocation and performance.
* Mentor junior project managers and functional leads.

**Testing and Deployment**

* Oversee:
  + SIT (System Integration Testing)
  + UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
  + Performance Testing
  + Security Testing
  + Cutover Planning
  + Go-Live Readiness

**Change Management & Training**

* Drive organizational change management activities.
* Ensure user adoption strategy and training plans are executed.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer sessions and hypercare support.

**Required Qualifications**
  
**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, or equivalent.
* MBA/PGDM preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **10+ years of SAP project management experience**.
* Minimum **2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation projects** as Project Manager.
* At least **1 Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation** experience.
* Experience working with Government, PSU, Utilities, Power Distribution, Electricity Board, or DISCOM organizations preferred.
* Experience managing projects valued above ₹20 Crore preferred.

**Mandatory Skills**

* SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE)
* SAP Activate Methodology
* SAP Project Management
* Greenfield Implementation Experience
* Program Governance
* Risk Management
* Budget and Resource Management
* Vendor Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management
* Agile and Waterfall Delivery Models
* SAP Solution Manager / Cloud ALM
* Strong Documentation and Reporting Skills

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Activate Project Manager Certification
* SAP S/4HANA Project Management Certification
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* PMI-ACP (Preferred)
* ITIL Foundation

**Desired Industry Experience**
  
Preference will be given to candidates having experience in:

* Power Distribution Utilities (DISCOM)
* State Electricity Boards (SEB)
* Energy & Utilities Sector
* Government ERP Projects
* Smart Metering Programs
* Utility Asset Management Projects

**Key Competencies**

* Leadership and Team Management
* Executive Communication
* Government Stakeholder Handling
* Conflict Resolution
* Negotiation Skills
* Strategic Planning
* Analytical Thinking
* Decision Making
* Problem Solving
* Customer Focus

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: Program Director / Engagement Manager
* Customer Interface: DISCOM Leadership, IT Head, Finance Head, Operations Head, PMU, Government Officials
* Team Size Managed: 25-100+ SAP and Technical Resources

**Location & Travel**

* **Work Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Site)
* Willingness to work onsite throughout project duration.
* Travel within DISCOM operational locations as required.

**Success Criteria**

* On-time project delivery
* Budget adherence
* Successful SAP S/4HANA go-live
* User adoption and business process transformation
* Compliance with government and utility regulations
* Customer satisfaction and stabilization during hypercare phase

This role is ideal for a senior SAP Project Manager with strong SAP S/4HANA transformation experience and proven delivery capability in Government Utility/DISCOM environments.

Qualifications

Graduate

Range of Year Experience-Min Year

9

Range of Year Experience-Max Year

11

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Description: SAP MM Functional Consultant (SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition SaaS - Greenfield Implementation)**
  
**Position Title:** SAP MM Functional Consultant
  
**Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Site)
  
**Customer:** Government DISCOM (Power Distribution Utility)
  
**Project Type:** SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) SaaS Greenfield Implementation
  
**Experience Required:** 10+ Years Relevant Experience
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Role Overview**
  
We are seeking a highly experienced **SAP Materials Management (MM) Functional Consultant** to participate in a large-scale **SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) Greenfield Implementation** for a Government Power Distribution Utility (DISCOM).
  
The consultant will be responsible for business process consulting, solution design, configuration, testing, user training, and deployment of SAP MM processes, ensuring alignment with utility industry best practices and government procurement regulations. The role requires extensive experience in procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, material valuation, and integration with other SAP modules.
  
The consultant will work onsite at the customer location in Patna and collaborate with business users, project stakeholders, and implementation teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Business Process Consulting**

* Conduct business process workshops and requirement gathering sessions with DISCOM stakeholders.
* Analyze existing procurement and inventory management processes.
* Map business requirements to SAP S/4HANA MM best practices.
* Prepare Business Blueprint, Functional Design Documents (FDD), and process flow diagrams.
* Recommend process improvements leveraging SAP S/4HANA capabilities.

**SAP MM Solution Design & Configuration**
  
Configure and support SAP S/4HANA MM processes including:
  
**Procurement Management**

* Purchase Requisition Management
* Request for Quotation (RFQ)
* Vendor Quotation Processing
* Purchase Order Processing
* Contract Management
* Outline Agreements
* Rate Contracts
* Service Procurement
* Emergency Procurement

**Inventory Management**

* Goods Receipt
* Goods Issue
* Stock Transfer
* Material Reservation
* Physical Inventory
* Inventory Reconciliation
* Batch Management
* Stock Monitoring

**Warehouse & Stores Operations**

* Warehouse Management Processes
* Material Tracking
* Bin Management
* Material Movement Monitoring
* Spare Parts Management
* Utility Stores Management

**Material Master Management**

* Material Creation and Governance
* Classification
* Valuation
* Material Grouping
* Coding Standards
* Master Data Harmonization

**Utility Procurement Process Implementation**
  
Support procurement processes related to:

* Transformers
* Meters and Smart Meters
* Conductors and Cables
* Switchgear Equipment
* Distribution Assets
* Maintenance Spares
* Capital Project Materials
* Consumables and Operational Inventory

Implement procurement workflows aligned with Government and Utility procurement policies.
  
**Integration Responsibilities**
  
Work closely with functional and technical teams for integration with:
  
**SAP FI/CO**

* Account Determination
* Material Valuation
* Invoice Verification
* Budget Controls

**SAP EAM / PM**

* Maintenance Spare Procurement
* Maintenance Inventory Management
* Work Order Material Consumption

**SAP PS**

* Project Procurement
* Capital Project Material Tracking
* WBS Based Procurement

**SAP SD**

* Intercompany Stock Transfers
* Material Availability Management

**SAP Ariba (if applicable)**

* Supplier Collaboration
* Strategic Sourcing
* Procurement Automation

**SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Implementation Activities**

* Participate in Fit-to-Standard workshops.
* Configure SAP S/4HANA MM solutions using SAP Activate methodology.
* Prepare configuration documents and functional specifications.
* Review RICEFW objects impacting MM processes.
* Support SAP Best Practices implementation.
* Assist with data migration activities.

**Data Migration**

* Material Master Migration
* Vendor Master Migration
* Open Purchase Orders
* Inventory Balances
* Contracts and Scheduling Agreements

**Activities include:**

* Data Assessment
* Cleansing
* Validation
* Mock Migration
* Cutover Support
* Reconciliation

**Testing Responsibilities**
  
Lead and support:

* Unit Testing
* System Integration Testing (SIT)
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Regression Testing
* Cutover Testing

**Responsibilities include:**

* Test Script Preparation
* Defect Resolution
* Business Validation
* Go-Live Readiness Support

**Training & Knowledge Transfer**

* Conduct end-user training programs.
* Develop training manuals and SOPs.
* Prepare process documentation.
* Facilitate change management activities.
* Support post-go-live knowledge transfer.

**Go-Live & Hypercare Support**

* Support cutover execution.
* Resolve production issues.
* Monitor procurement and inventory transactions.
* Assist business users during stabilization phase.
* Ensure successful transition to support teams.

**Required Qualifications**
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Commerce, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* MBA in Operations/Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 10+ years of SAP MM consulting experience.
* Minimum 2 end-to-end SAP implementation projects.
* Minimum 1 SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation project.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition implementation preferred.
* Experience working with Government, PSU, Utilities, Power Sector, or DISCOM organizations preferred.
* Experience managing large-scale procurement and inventory processes.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
  
**SAP MM Functional Expertise**

* Procurement Lifecycle Management
* Inventory Management
* Material Master Management
* Invoice Verification
* Release Strategies
* Valuation and Account Determination
* Physical Inventory
* Subcontracting
* Consignment Processes
* Service Procurement

**SAP S/4HANA Knowledge**

* SAP S/4HANA Procurement
* SAP Fiori Applications
* Business Partner Integration
* Embedded Analytics
* SAP Activate Methodology
* SAP Best Practices

**Integration Knowledge**

* SAP FI/CO
* SAP EAM/PM
* SAP PS
* SAP SD
* SAP Ariba (Preferred)
* SAP MDG (Preferred)

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement
* SAP S/4HANA Procurement Certification
* SAP Activate Project Certification
* SAP Ariba Procurement Certification

**Preferred Domain Experience**
  
Candidates with experience in the following sectors will be preferred:

* Power Distribution Utilities (DISCOM)
* State Electricity Boards (SEB)
* Electricity Transmission & Distribution
* Energy & Utilities
* Government ERP Projects
* Public Sector Undertakings (PSU)
* Infrastructure Projects

**Key Competencies**

* Strong Functional Consulting Skills
* Requirement Gathering & Process Mapping
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Process Transformation
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
* Documentation and Presentation Skills
* Client-Facing Communication
* Team Collaboration
* Change Management Support

**Reporting Structure**
  
**Reports To:** SAP MM Lead / Solution Architect / Project Manager
  
**Key Stakeholders:**

* DISCOM Procurement Department
* Materials & Stores Department
* Finance Department
* Asset Management Team
* PMO Team
* Government Nodal Officers
* SAP Project Leadership

**Location Requirement**

* **Work Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Premises)
* Full-time onsite deployment during project implementation.
* Willingness to travel to field offices, warehouses, divisional stores, and utility locations within the DISCOM operational area as required.

**Success Criteria**

* Successful implementation of SAP S/4HANA MM processes.
* Seamless integration with Finance, Asset Management, and Project Systems.
* Accurate inventory and procurement data migration.
* Compliance with Government procurement policies and audit requirements.
* User adoption and operational efficiency improvements.
* Stable and successful go-live with minimal business disruption.

Qualifications

Graduate

Range of Year Experience-Min Year

10

Range of Year Experience-Max Year

15

title: Senior Territory Manager -Patna
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager - Poultry**

As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
* **Top Skills:** Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.

**Additional Information:**

* **Location:** Based in India – field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* **Travel:** Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.
